refinementPasses.performance: Regional means cache logarithmic levels by world and immutable district cell array; commissioning invalidates the cache, and the live coefficient is read on every query. A deterministic contract checks 100,000 repeated capacity calls without rescanning cells. A shared pending index bounds batch selection to the district/cell scan plus sorting, rather than rescanning all projects per selected site. Fully cash-funded construction bypasses a domestic supplier-credit survey; automatic batches cap full commitments including supplier liabilities.
refinementPasses.style: Repository formatter completed; new modules and formulas document domain rationale, units, accounting and cache invalidation. Model and rendering documentation updated.
